issues: Document is the Annual Report containing a CONCISE financial report (AASB 1039), not the full statutory financial report; the consolidated statement of financial performance is complete, but notes are abbreviated (no expense or employee notes, no geographic segment).

Pre-AIFRS (AGAAP): 'Revenue from ordinary activities' includes other revenue (40.9) and the cost side includes 'Carrying amount of non-current assets sold' (9.9), i.e. asset-sale proceeds are grossed up in revenue. Note 4 gives sales revenue 7,940.7.

By-nature presentation: no cost of sales / gross profit / SG&A; selling_general_admin_lines left empty. Remaining by-nature lines (external services, freight, other expenses, carrying amount of NCA sold) are in income_statement_lines.
